mapper.select: SELECT CAST(f.article_id AS CHAR) AS articleId,f.kind,a.title,u.nick_name AS authorName,f.created_at AS createdAt FROM recommendation_feedback f LEFT JOIN article_info a ON a.article_id=f.article_id LEFT JOIN user_info u ON u.user_id=f.target_author_id WHERE f.user_id=#{userId} ORDER BY f.created_at DESC,f.article_id DESC LIMIT 200
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM recommendation_feedback WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND article_id=#{articleId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO recommendation_feedback(user_id,article_id,target_author_id,kind) VALUES (#{userId},#{articleId},#{authorId},#{kind}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE kind=VALUES(kind),target_author_id=VALUES(target_author_id),created_at=NOW(3)
